## Output — copy exactly this format

```markdown
## Summary
<one line, imperative, <70 chars>

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1: <text from spec>
- [ ] AC2: <text from spec>
- [ ] AC3: <text from spec>

## Affected components
<comma-separated list from spec's affected_components>

## What changed
<3–5 bullets, one per meaningful file or concept>

## Verification
- Tests: <pass/fail summary from test output>
- Grader: <pass/fail from grader verdict, one-line reason>
- Eval delta (if prompts changed): <baseline → new>

## Follow-ups
- [ ] <backfill, reindex, monitoring, or docs update needed>
- [ ] <or "none">
```

Do not include a "generated by" footer. Do not embed the raw trace log.
Do not add sections I did not ask for.
